section_title: The Six Trigonometric Ratios: Sine, Cosine, Tangent and Their Reciprocals
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0.0s - 12.2s) - Intro to right triangles
title = Text("Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*2,
    color=WHITE,
    fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(ORIGIN, UR, buff=0)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 2 (12.2s - 24.4s) - Label angle A and sides
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=np.arctan(2/3), color=YELLOW)
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
self.play(
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 3 (24.4s - 36.0s) - Label triangle sides
opp = Line(RIGHT*3, UP*2, color=RED)
adj = Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, color=BLUE)
hyp = Line(ORIGIN, UP*2, color=GREEN)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24, color=RED).next_to(opp, RIGHT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24, color=BLUE).next_to(adj, DOWN)
hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", font_size=24, color=GREEN).next_to(hyp, LEFT)

self.play(
    Transform(triangle.get_edge_center(RIGHT), opp),
    Transform(triangle.get_edge_center(UP), adj),
    Transform(triangle.get_diagonal(), hyp),
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label), 
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 4 (36.0s - 52.3s) - First three ratios
sine_formula = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}", color=YELLOW)
sine_formula.to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)
self.play(Write(sine_formula), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.2)

# Segment 5 (52.3s - 72.6s) - SOH CAH TOA
cos_formula = MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}", color=YELLOW)
tan_formula = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}", color=YELLOW)
sohcahtoa = Text("SOH CAH TOA", font_size=36, color=GOLD)

cos_formula.next_to(sine_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)
tan_formula.next_to(cos_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)
sohcahtoa.to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    Write(cos_formula),
    Write(tan_formula),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(Write(sohcahtoa), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 6 (72.6s - 88.3s) - Reciprocal ratios
csc_formula = MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{1}{\sin A} = \frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{opposite}}", color=BLUE)
csc_formula.to_edge(LEFT).shift(DOWN)
self.play(Write(csc_formula), run_time=4)
self.wait(11.7)

# Segment 7 (88.3s - 107.6s) - More reciprocals
sec_formula = MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{1}{\cos A} = \frac{\text{hypotenuse}}{\text{adjacent}}", color=BLUE)
cot_formula = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A} = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{opposite}}", color=BLUE)

sec_formula.next_to(csc_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)
cot_formula.next_to(sec_formula, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    Write(sec_formula),
    Write(cot_formula),
    run_time=6
)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 8 (107.6s - 117.8s) - Summary
summary_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(
    sine_formula, cos_formula, tan_formula,
    csc_formula, sec_formula, cot_formula
), color=GOLD)
self.play(Create(summary_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.2)

section_title: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Tangent
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-15.7s) - Given tangent A = 4/3
title = Text("Finding All Trig Ratios from Tangent", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}", font_size=48).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(given), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.7)

# Segment 2 (15.7-28.9s) - Goal and right triangle
goal_text = Text("Find: sin A, cos A, csc A, sec A, cot A", font_size=32)
goal_text.next_to(given, DOWN, buff=0.75)

# Create right triangle
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*4,
    color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
)
triangle.scale(0.8).shift(DOWN*0.5 + LEFT*3)

    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 3 (28.9-55.3s) - Label triangle sides
opp_label = MathTex("4", color=YELLOW).next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[1], RIGHT)
adj_label = MathTex("3", color=GREEN).next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], DOWN)
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.4, angle=np.arctan(4/3), color=WHITE)
angle_A.shift(triangle.get_vertices()[0])
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(20.4)

# Segment 4 (55.3-77.2s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth = MathTex(r"c^2 = 4^2 + 3^2 = 16 + 9 = 25").next_to(goal_text, DOWN, buff=0.75)

self.wait(18.8)

# Segment 5 (77.2-122.3s) - Calculate all ratios

hyp_label.next_to(triangle.get_center(), UR, buff=0.1)

ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}"),
    MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}"),
    MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
ratios.next_to(pyth, DOWN, buff=0.75)

self.play(Write(hyp_label), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios[2]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios[3]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios[4]), run_time=2)
self.wait(33.2)

section_title: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-22.3s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality").to_edge(UP)
problem = MathTex(r"\text{If }\sin B = \sin Q\text{, then }B = Q").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.7)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=2.5)
self.wait(17.8)

# Segment 2 (22.3-37.1s) - Setting up triangles
# First triangle ABC
triangle_abc = VGroup()
point_a = [-3, -1, 0]
point_b = [-1, 1, 0] 
point_c = [-3, 1, 0]
triangle_abc.add(
    Line(point_a, point_b, color=BLUE),
    Line(point_b, point_c, color=BLUE),
    Line(point_c, point_a, color=BLUE)
)
labels_abc = VGroup(
    Text("A").next_to(point_a, DOWN),
    Text("B").next_to(point_b, RIGHT),
    Text("C").next_to(point_c, LEFT)
)

# Second triangle PQR
triangle_pqr = VGroup()
point_p = [1, -1, 0]
point_q = [3, 1, 0]
point_r = [1, 1, 0]
triangle_pqr.add(
    Line(point_p, point_q, color=RED),
    Line(point_q, point_r, color=RED),
    Line(point_r, point_p, color=RED)
)
labels_pqr = VGroup(
    Text("P").next_to(point_p, DOWN),
    Text("Q").next_to(point_q, RIGHT),
    Text("R").next_to(point_r, LEFT)
)

self.play(
    Create(triangle_abc),
    Create(triangle_pqr),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(labels_abc),
    Write(labels_pqr),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(9.7)

# Segment 3 (37.1-57.9s) - Defining sine ratios
sine_b = MathTex(r"\sin B = \frac{AC}{AB}").next_to(triangle_abc, DOWN)
sine_q = MathTex(r"\sin Q = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(triangle_pqr, DOWN)

highlight_ac = Line(point_a, point_c, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
highlight_ab = Line(point_a, point_b, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
highlight_pr = Line(point_p, point_r, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
highlight_pq = Line(point_p, point_q, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)

self.play(Write(sine_b), Write(sine_q), run_time=3)
self.play(
    ShowPassingFlash(highlight_ac),
    ShowPassingFlash(highlight_ab),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    ShowPassingFlash(highlight_pr),
    ShowPassingFlash(highlight_pq),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(13.8)

# Segment 4 (57.9-80.7s) - Rearranging proportions
proportion = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(problem, DOWN, buff=1)
rearranged = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k").next_to(proportion, DOWN)

self.play(Write(proportion), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(rearranged), run_time=3)
self.wait(16.9)

# Segment 5 (80.7-105.6s) - Pythagorean theorem for ABC
pyth_abc = MathTex(r"BC^2 = AB^2 - AC^2").next_to(rearranged, DOWN)
bc_expr = MathTex(r"BC = k\sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}").next_to(pyth_abc, DOWN)

self.play(Write(pyth_abc), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(bc_expr), run_time=3)
self.wait(18.9)

# Segment 6 (105.6-124.9s) - Pythagorean theorem for PQR
pyth_pqr = MathTex(r"QR = \sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}").next_to(bc_expr, DOWN)
ratio_bc_qr = MathTex(r"\frac{BC}{QR} = k").next_to(pyth_pqr, DOWN)

self.play(Write(pyth_pqr), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(ratio_bc_qr), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 7 (124.9-145.2s) - All ratios equal k
final_ratios = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = \frac{BC}{QR} = k").next_to(ratio_bc_qr, DOWN)
self.play(Write(final_ratios), run_time=3)
self.wait(17.3)

# Segment 8 (145.2-164.5s) - Conclusion
conclusion = Text("Therefore, triangles ABC and PQR are similar\nand angle B = angle Q", font_size=36).next_to(final_ratios, DOWN)
self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=4)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 1 (0-8.1s) - Introduction to identity
title = MathTex(r"\cos^2 \theta + \sin^2 \theta = 1").scale(1.5).to_edge(UP)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 2 (8.1-21.3s) - Link to Pythagorean theorem
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*2.5,
    color=WHITE,
    fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(ORIGIN, UR, buff=0)

self.play(
    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=3
)

theta = MathTex(r"\theta").next_to(ORIGIN, DR, buff=0.3)
self.play(Write(theta), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 3 (21.3-41.6s) - Define sine and cosine ratios
opp = Line(RIGHT*3, UP*2.5, color=BLUE)
adj = Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, color=RED)
hyp = Line(ORIGIN, UP*2.5+RIGHT*3, color=GREEN)

labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("\\text{opp}").next_to(opp, RIGHT),
    MathTex("\\text{adj}").next_to(adj, DOWN),
    MathTex("\\text{hyp}").next_to(hyp, UL)
)

ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opp}}{\text{hyp}}", color=BLUE),
    MathTex(r"\cos \theta = \frac{\text{adj}}{\text{hyp}}", color=RED)
).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    Create(opp),
    Create(adj), 
    Create(hyp),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(labels), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(ratios), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 4 (41.6-60.4s) - Square the ratios
squared_ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin^2 \theta = \frac{\text{opp}^2}{\text{hyp}^2}", color=BLUE),
    MathTex(r"\cos^2 \theta = \frac{\text{adj}^2}{\text{hyp}^2}", color=RED)
).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(ratios, squared_ratios),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(15.8)

# Segment 5 (60.4-98.5s) - Add ratios and apply Pythagorean theorem
sum_eq = MathTex(
    r"\sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta &= \frac{\text{opp}^2}{\text{hyp}^2} + \frac{\text{adj}^2}{\text{hyp}^2} \\",
    r"&= \frac{\text{opp}^2 + \text{adj}^2}{\text{hyp}^2} \\",
    r"&= \frac{\text{hyp}^2}{\text{hyp}^2} \\",
    r"&= 1"
).shift(DOWN)

self.play(
    Write(sum_eq[0]),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(
    Write(sum_eq[1]),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(
    Write(sum_eq[2:]),
    run_time=4
)

final_highlight = SurroundingRectangle(title, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(final_highlight), run_time=2)
self.wait(24.1)

# Segment 1 (0-14.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Verifying: 2sinA⋅cosA = 1 when tanA = 1", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
problem = MathTex(
    r"\text{Given: }", r"\tan A = 1",
    r"\text{ Prove: }", r"2\sin A \cos A = 1"
).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 2 (14.2-35.5s) - Right triangle construction
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*3,
    color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.4).next_to(ORIGIN, UR, buff=0)
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.6, angle=PI/4, color=YELLOW)
x_label = MathTex("x").next_to(RIGHT*1.5, DOWN, buff=0.2)
x_label2 = MathTex("x").next_to(UP*1.5, LEFT, buff=0.2)
tan_eq = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}} = \frac{x}{x} = 1")
tan_eq.next_to(triangle, RIGHT, buff=2)

self.play(Create(triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(angle_A), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(x_label), Write(x_label2), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(tan_eq), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 3 (35.5-61.9s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth = MathTex(r"h^2 = x^2 + x^2").next_to(tan_eq, DOWN, buff=1)
pyth2 = MathTex(r"h^2 = 2x^2").next_to(pyth, DOWN)
hyp = MathTex(r"h = x\sqrt{2}").next_to(pyth2, DOWN)
h_label = MathTex(r"x\sqrt{2}").next_to(triangle.get_center(), UR, buff=0.3)

self.play(Write(pyth), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(pyth2), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(hyp), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(h_label), run_time=3)
self.wait(14.4)

# Segment 4 (61.9-81.7s) - Sine and Cosine
sine_calc = MathTex(
    r"\sin A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{x}{x\sqrt{2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}"
).next_to(hyp, DOWN, buff=1)
cos_calc = MathTex(
    r"\cos A = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{x}{x\sqrt{2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}"
).next_to(sine_calc, DOWN)

self.play(Write(sine_calc), run_time=5)
self.play(Write(cos_calc), run_time=5)
self.wait(9.8)

# Segment 5 (81.7-122.9s) - Final verification
verify1 = MathTex(
    r"2\sin A \cos A = 2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}"
).next_to(cos_calc, DOWN, buff=1)
verify2 = MathTex(
    r"= 2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 1"
).next_to(verify1, DOWN)
box = SurroundingRectangle(verify2, color=GREEN)

self.play(Write(verify1), run_time=5)
self.play(Write(verify2), run_time=5)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=3)
self.wait(28.1)

section_title: Finding sinQ and cosQ from Side Relationships
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0.0-12.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding Sine and Cosine from Side Relationships", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Using triangle side relationships", font_size=24).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 2 (12.2-34.5s) - Setup triangle with relationships
triangle_group = VGroup()
A = np.array([-3, -2, 0])
B = np.array([1, -2, 0]) 
C = np.array([-3, 1, 0])
triangle = Polygon(A, B, C, color=WHITE)
right_angle = RightAngle(Line(B, A), Line(B, C), length=0.3)
angle_Q = Angle(Line(C, A), Line(A, B), radius=0.5, color=YELLOW)
Q_label = MathTex("Q").next_to(angle_Q, LEFT)

relationship = MathTex(r"\text{opposite} = 3(\text{adjacent}) - 1").next_to(triangle, DOWN, buff=1)
hyp_text = MathTex(r"\text{hypotenuse} = 5").next_to(relationship, DOWN)

self.play(
    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    Create(angle_Q),
    Write(Q_label),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(Write(relationship), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(hyp_text), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 3 (34.5-57.4s) - Label sides with variables
x_label = MathTex("x").next_to(B, DOWN)
y_label = MathTex("y").next_to(C, LEFT)
h_label = MathTex("5").next_to((A + B)/2, RIGHT)

goal = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{Find:}"),
    MathTex(r"\sin Q = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}"),
    MathTex(r"\cos Q = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}")
).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    Write(x_label),
    Write(y_label),
    Write(h_label),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(Write(goal), run_time=6)
self.wait(12.9)

# Segment 4 (57.4-73.6s) - Show relationships
equation1 = MathTex(r"y = 3x - 1").to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)
equation2 = MathTex(r"x^2 + y^2 = 5^2").next_to(equation1, DOWN)

self.play(Write(equation1), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(equation2), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 5 (73.6-129.5s) - Solution steps
steps = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"x^2 + (3x-1)^2 = 25"),
    MathTex(r"x^2 + 9x^2 - 6x + 1 = 25"),
    MathTex(r"10x^2 - 6x - 24 = 0"),
    MathTex(r"x = \frac{6 \pm \sqrt{36 + 960}}{20}"),
    MathTex(r"x = \frac{6 + \sqrt{996}}{20}"),
    MathTex(r"y = 3(\frac{6 + \sqrt{996}}{20}) - 1"),
    MathTex(r"\sin Q = \frac{y}{5}, \cos Q = \frac{x}{5}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4).shift(RIGHT * 3)

for i, step in enumerate(steps):
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=4)
    self.wait(3.7 if i < len(steps)-1 else 7.8)
